RESIDENCE ZONE NO. 5-(R-5 ZONE)
A. In the R-5 Zone, only the following buildings, structures and uses shall be permitted: 
(1) All buildings, structures and uses permitted in an R-4 Zone.
(2) Attached and semi-detached dwellings.
(3) Attached buildings for any of the non-dwelling uses permitted in an R-3 Zone.
B. In an R-5 Zone, no building or structure shall exceed forty-five (45) feet in height, unless each required side yard is increased in width by one (1) foot for every unit of ten (10) feet of additional height above forty (40) feet.
C. In an R-5 Zone, each lot shall have front, side, and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yard—depth, five (5) feet or conform to existing setback, within the block.
(2) a. Side yards—width, ten (10%) percent of the lot width. 
b. The width of a side yard abutting a major street shall equal the required depth of the front yard.
(3) Rear yard—depth, five (5) feet or ten (10%) percent of the lot depth whichever is greater.
CENTRAL OFFICE ZONE-(CO ZONE)
A. In a CO Zone, only the following buildings, structures and uses shall be permitted: 
(1) All buildings, structures and uses permitted in an R-1 Zone.
(2) Detached multiple dwellings.
(3) Detached buildings for any of the non-dwelling uses permitted in an R-3 Zone.
(4) Detached buildings for any of the non-dwelling uses permitted in an R-4 Zone.
(5) Two or three family detached dwellings treated as a unified whole or as manor-group dwellings.
(6) Funeral Homes.
(7) The following commercial uses when entirely within a building, if at least fifty per cent (50%) of the gross enclosed floor area of the building, exclusive of parking areas, is utilized for residential uses, and provided the area utilized for such commercial uses (not including accessory uses otherwise permitted in a CO Zone) does not exceed eight per cent (8%) of the gross enclosed floor area of the building, exclusive of parking areas; 
a. Banks, trust companies, and savings and loan associations.
b. Food commissaries.
c. Restaurant and cocktail lounges.
d. Retail specialty shops such as florists, gift shops, drugstores, jewelry stores, men's and ladies' apparel shops, and shoe stores."
B. In a CO Zone, no building or structure shall exceed one hundred (100) feet in height, unless each required side yard is increased in width by one foot for every unit of ten (10) feet of additional height above one hundred (100) feet.
C. In a CO Zone, each lot shall have front, side, and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yards: 
a. North Front Street, Reily to the City Line-depth, fifty (50) feet.
b. Remainder of CO Zone—depth, ten (10) feet or conform to existing setbacks, within the block.
(2) a. Side yards—Side yards shall be an open area on each aide not less than ten percent of the entire lot width in depth, running the entire length of the lot.
b. Side yards abutting a major street shall be at least fifteen feet in depth.
(3) Rear yards—depth, fifteen (15) feet or ten (10%) percent of lot depth, whichever is greater.
BUSINESS LOCAL ZONE—(BL ZONE)
A. In a BL Zone, only the following buildings, structures and uses shall be permitted: 
(1) All buildings, structures and uses permitted in any Residence Zone.
(2) Neighborhood retail stores, grocery, dairy or confectionery.
(3) Service and repair shops for household and personal effects, appliances and equipment.
(4) Personal service shops such as barber, beautician, shoeshine and bath parlors.
(5) Drug stores, refreshment stands, snack shops, cut rate stores or card shops.
(6) Dance Halls or gymnasiums.
(7) Printing shops.
(8) Commercial parking lots.
(9) Theatres, or auditoriums.
The following artisan uses are permitted in a BL Zone if not more than ten (10) persons are employed on the site, and if there is no open storage of stock, raw material, waste or equipment visible from a street or alley: 
(1) Carpentry, cabinet making and upholstery.
(2) Electrical work.
(3) Pest exterminating or fumigating.
(4) Painting or decorating.
(5) Plumbing.
(6) Auto repairing and polishing.
(7) Laundromats or dry cleaning pick-up and delivery not open all night.
(8) Machinist and general repairman.
(9) Bakery, when at least fifty (50%) percent of the product is sold at retail on the site to the ultimate consumer.
(10) Local ice, wood or coal dealer.
B. In a BL Zone, no building or structure shall exceed sixty (60) feet in height.
C. In a BL Zone, each lot shall have front, side, and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yard—depth, five (5) feet.
(2) a. Side yards—(2)  width, ten (10) feet each side of a principal building, provided that when a written agreement is provided by adjoining property owners no side yard shall be required where commercial uses abut side to side. However, in no case shall party walls be permitted between properties of separate ownership.
b. The width of a side yard abutting a major street shall equal the depth of a front yard.
(8) Rear yard—depth, five (5) feet.
